contract.description: SHA-256 compression. Input high 256 bits: chaining state, h0 first; low 512 bits: message block, first byte most significant. Output updated state, h0 first. All arithmetic modulo 2^32. Use a 16-word rolling schedule and 64 iterative rounds. Accept arbitrary 256-bit chaining states and arbitrary 512-bit blocks. Host pads messages; every compression round and state addition must be hardware.
